assertions.statement: Only the gate, the observer and the enumerated control-plane clients connect to the apiserver port
Only the apiserver binds the apiserver port
Only the gate binds the I04 port
Only the server connects to the I04 port
Only the apiserver connects to the datastore socket
Only the kubelet connects to the container runtime socket
Only the broker connects to I05
Only the policy writer connects to I07
The gate is the sole reader of its two upstream credentials
Only the apiserver and controller-manager read the service-account signing key
Only its owner reads planeon_observer_cred_t
Only its owner reads planeon_server_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_apiserver_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_controller_manager_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_encryption_key_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_kubelet_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_netpol_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_proxy_cred_t
Only its owner reads qualk8s_scheduler_cred_t
No domain writes or relabels a sealed type in an enrolled boot
In the maintenance boot only the maintenance domain writes or relabels a sealed type
Containment loads BPF programs only before the seal; the runtime is the narrow E1 exception
After the seal and in maintenance only the runtime loads (cgroup-device) programs
Enrolled programs are map-free: no domain creates, reads or writes a BPF map
Only the reader roles obtain containment-owned program descriptors
Before the seal only containment sets booleans
After the seal no domain sets a boolean, loads policy or switches enforcing mode
In the maintenance boot only the maintenance domain changes booleans or loads policy
No domain ever switches SELinux to permissive
Only init enters containment, only before the seal
Nothing enters containment after the seal or in maintenance
Only the admin domain enters maintenance, only in the maintenance boot
Nothing enters maintenance in an enrolled boot
Only init starts the resident daemon roles
Only the broker starts the worker
No planeon role starts in the maintenance boot
Only the admin login enters the policy writer, through its entrypoint
No dynamic transition or setexec into any declared domain
No domain ptraces a declared domain
No execmem, execstack or execheap
Only init, containment and the reader roles search or open planeon cgroup directories and files
Only init writes the planeon slice and the server, observer, gate and containment cgroups
Only init and the broker write the broker's delegated cgroups
Only containment relabels planeon cgroups, only before the seal
No domain holds CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH, in the initial or any user namespace
No domain holds CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH in a user namespace
Only the confined kubelet and runtime hold CAP_SYS_ADMIN; no planeon domain or admin does
Only containment and the reader roles read bpffs pins
Only containment creates or labels pins, only before the seal
Only containment writes the seal marker, only before the seal; nothing after
Only the gate reads or writes its journal in an enrolled boot
Only the datastore touches its data in an enrolled boot
Only systemd starts, stops or reloads planeon and backend units in an enrolled boot
CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE only for the server and gate (enrolled only with a signed port below 1024), the admin login and the runtime

planeon_containment_enabled.meaning: containment may run; cleared at S4

planeon_maintenance_mode.meaning: set early only by the maintenance boot entry

secure_mode_policyload.meaning: set at S4; freezes booleans, policy load and enforcing mode until reboot
